input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (owner's standing ventures brief)
task: Deepen (flagship 11): chant-forge, item '-unt read on its stop'

errors.what: dev sweep with two settings in one foreground call hit the 120 s tool timeout
errors.fix: stopped it; ran long evals with run_in_background

doc_friction.issue: chant-forge's next named 'G control false nasals 44' as an item, but G's misses and control reads were printed when the last round was scored, so no clean held-out set is left for it; I left it in next with '(needs a fresh held-out set)'

every corpus part (B, D, E, H, I, F) has now had its misses printed in some round, so 'held out' in its headers is historical; pre-registering predictions on all parts and tuning on synthetic syllables (part J) was the honest substitute

deviations.why: allocator's flagship pick (chant-forge) taken on a reader-accuracy item rather than a new revenue product; it is the routed default and a self-contained, measurable slice
deviations.did: landed the cluster-nasal rule with a pre-registration

goal: chant-forge synthetic choir: the checker reads the n of -unt/-sunt/-ens clusters
notes: readCoda gains PRE (onsets.mjs): a dark run entered by an 8 dB tilt step, 40 ms+, ending within 5 frames of a stop closure or fricative, reads as the cluster's nasal. Tuned on synthetic part J only (cluster nasals 46->124/132; others 304/336 and control 445/468 unchanged). Registration committed (52bd21685) before corpus runs. Results vs --pre off: A 160->168/180 (unt/ant 7->12 of 12); F nasals 106->116/137, /l/ 4/4; B 155->157, D 68, E 82, H 126->128, I 138; corpus cluster nasals 7->11 of 11; controls and bare rows identical. chant-forge suite 260 tests pass (run_venture_tests.py). Post checks: front matter, links, similarity clean. Not listened to.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an audio DSP engineer diagnosing the cluster miss frame by frame, designing and pre-registering the rule, running the checks and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
